config.name: Latest release of each DFE component
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toString(_json._dfe_fetcher_repo) AS "Component",
       argMax(toString(_json.tag_name), parseDateTimeBestEffortOrZero(toString(_json.published_at))) AS "Latest version",
       max(parseDateTimeBestEffortOrZero(toString(_json.published_at))) AS "Published",
       dateDiff('hour', max(parseDateTimeBestEffortOrZero(toString(_json.published_at))), now()) AS "Age (hours)"
FROM dfe.`component-releases`
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 3 DESC

config.name: Release rows landed
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT $__timeInterval(_timestamp_load) AS ts,
       count() AS "rows landed"
FROM dfe.`component-releases`
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp_load)
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts
